description: Read one durable A2UI surface, including its flat component graph and data model, from the current Harness session.

request_schema.description: Select one surface in the current Harness session.

surface_id.description: Stable surface id returned by generate, apply, or list.

request_schema.title: GetRequest

BindingQuery.description: Read-only query the worker that hosts an observed event function exposes for the current data. The function must be registered by the same worker as the observed function with metadata `{"read_only": true}`.

function_id.description: Provider function that returns the current value.

payload.description: Fixed request payload, validated against the function's request schema.

result_path.description: JSON Pointer inside the query result to apply. Defaults to the whole result.

component.description: Component name from the negotiated catalog.

id.description: Unique component id within the surface. `root` is the render root.

LiveBinding.description: Declarative live-data binding rendered by the Console: the page observes `function_id` (with `args` and `filters`) for its own view and writes delivered values to `target_path`. Bindings cannot invoke arbitrary functions.

args.description: Args for a function that takes them, validated against the function's registered `args_format`.

event_path.description: JSON Pointer inside the event to apply (event mode only).

filters.description: Filters selecting which calls are delivered, each with an explicit operator: `{ "input.status": { "$eq": "open" } }`.

function_id.description: Function to observe: another worker's private event function (for example `orders::on-changed`), `state::on-changed`, or `shell::on-changed`. `stream::on-changed` is accepted only as deprecated legacy compatibility.

id.description: Stable binding id within the surface.

query.description: Optional provider query for a worker's event source: run for the initial read, after every notification, and on reconnect.

target_path.description: JSON Pointer in the surface data model that receives the value.

RetiredBinding.description: A binding stored under iii 0.25 as a worker's type `W::X` whose function `W::on-X` was not registered, or failed the binding checks, when its session loaded.

function_id.description: The function the stored type reads as.

reason.description: Why the binding could not be translated.

retired_bindings.description: Bindings stored under iii 0.25 that could not be translated when the session loaded, each with the reason. The page lists them; `a2ui::binding::set` with the same id replaces one and `a2ui::binding::delete` removes it.

session_id.description: Authoritative Harness session stamped by the pre-call hook.
